entities.name: CYP17A1 deficiency
observations: 17α-hydroxylase/17,20-lyase deficiency causes impaired cortisol and sex-steroid synthesis; deoxycorticosterone excess can cause hypertension and hypokalemia.

entities.name: Elevated FSH
observations: In CYP17A1 deficiency, reduced sex-steroid production impairs negative feedback and produces elevated gonadotropins, including FSH, in patients with absent pubertal development.
